title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Software Development:
- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.

- Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.

- Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:
- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.

- Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

- Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

- Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.

- Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.

- Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.

- Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

- Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:
- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.

- Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

- Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.

- Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:
- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

- May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.

- Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

- Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

- Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.

- Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:
- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

- Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

- Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:
- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

- Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:
- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:
- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:
- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Career Level - IC3

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
The Microsoft Data Security team’s mission is to building cloud solutions to support premium features that provide security, compliance, data governance, data loss prevention, and more, in a fully integrated manner from services to clients of Office 365 as well as Windows. We create global scale services to transport, store, secure and manage some of the most sensitive data on the planet and build our services on top of Azure, Exchange and other cloud platforms, and our experiences in Office applications like Outlook.
The IDC arm of the team is expanding substantially and is looking for talented and highly motivated engineers. This is an excellent opportunity for anyone who has, or wants to build, expertise in cloud distributed systems, or in security and compliance, or both. Team will be building cloud solutions meeting scales that few companies in the industry are required to support, that leverage state of the art technologies to deliver holistic protection to a planet scale user base. Office 365 is the industry leader in hosted productivity suites and boasts to be the fastest growing business at Microsoft with more than 100 million seats hosted in multiple data centers across the globe.
The MDS Engineering team provides leadership, direction and accountability for application architecture, Cloud design, infrastructures development and end to end implementation. You will independently determine and develop architectural approaches and Infrastructure solutions, conduct business reviews, and operate our production services. Strong collaboration skills will be required to work closely with other engineering teams to ensure services/systems are highly stable and performant and meet the expectations of internal and external customers and users.

Responsibilities
We are looking for someone who is a highly motivated, self-starter who thrives in a bottoms-up, fast paced, highly technical environment, has a strong customer focus and understands the importance of Live Site, has a demonstrated ability to establish and manage relationships across organizational boundaries, has proven experience dealing with large scale data architecture, operational architecture and or network Architecture and proven experience creating distributed systems tools of moderate-to-high complexity.
- You will be responsible to perform investigations and investments in complex areas; designing and delivering features end to end - including system architecture, code, deployment, scale, performance and quality, from conception to delivery.
- Design and develop large scale distributed software services and solutions Develop “best-in-class” engineering for our services by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored and reusable. 
- Consider testability, portability/monitoring, reliability, and maintainability, and understand when code is ready to be shared and delivered.
- Focus on customer/partner needs through a data driven approach.  Troubleshoot and optimize automation, reliability, and monitoring for LiveSite.  
- Adhere to modern engineering practices, effective coding, writing unit test cases, debugging, code reviewing and creating CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery) pipelines.
- Work across geographic and organizational boundaries to define requirements, scope work, develop features, integrate functionality, and meet key performance goals.
- Own and drive projects with large scope and complicated features by working toward self-defined goals and milestones. Have a sense of pride, commitment, and personal accountability for the service quality, completeness and resulting user experience for the life of the product or service 

Qualifications
- Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and common Design Patterns
- 4+ years of relevant software development experience and proficient in C# (Java or C++) 
- In-depth knowledge of cloud development (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) 
- Experience developing and shipping Azure Services is a plus 
- Experience and involvement with DevOps is a plus 
- Effective communication/collaboration skills, ability to deal with ambiguity and prioritize issues 
- Collaborating with technical partners to deliver end-to-end solutions 
- Experience with multithreading and asynchronous processing
- Experience with CI/CD pipeline using agile practices 
- Ability to quickly ramp up on multiple technology areas Interpersonal skills 
- Understanding of RBAC, observability and NPF
 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:

- Proficiency with SQL and databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
- Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git.
- Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and problem‑solving techniques.
- Exposure to Python frameworks like Django, Flask, or FastAPI (preferred).

- Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines (preferred).
- Excellent communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn new technologies.

Join Bristlecone India Limited as an Associate Software Engineer , developing Python‑based solutions for enterprise applications.

description:

Domestic Boilers | Heating Systems | Heat Pumps | HVAC Hydraulic Modules

title: Senior Software Engineer
location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore; India, Telangana, Hyderabad
description:
Overview
Azure AI Search is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Azure AI Knowledge team, building the knowledge retrieval platform for traditional search and generative AI experiences over enterprise data. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems at the intersection of AI, information retrieval, distributed systems, and large-scale cloud services. You will own significant technical areas from architecture and implementation through deployment, reliability, and customer success; work across team and organizational boundaries; make sound engineering decisions in ambiguous problem spaces; and raise the technical bar for the broader team. 

Azure AI Search is a globally distributed managed search service that enables developers to build secure, scalable search, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic AI applications over enterprise data. The service supports a broad range of workloads, usage patterns, and hosting models, while continuously improving search relevance, developer experience, scale, availability, performance, and operational efficiency. 

This is an opportunity to shape foundational capabilities in one of Microsoft’s most important areas—Data, Cloud, and AI—while delivering durable customer impact at global scale. 

We are a customer-obsessed, data-driven team committed to engineering excellence. We use open-source technologies, build in C#, C++, and Java, and value engineers who collaborate well, learn quickly, and use AI-assisted engineering practices to improve development velocity and quality.

Responsibilities
 
- Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-impact capabilities for Azure AI Search. 

- Own significant technical areas, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, reliability, security, and ongoing operations. 

- Make architectural and engineering decisions for distributed systems at cloud scale, balancing customer needs, performance, availability, cost, and long-term maintainability. 

- Identify ambiguous, cross-cutting problems, develop clear technical strategies, and drive execution across engineers and partner teams. 

- Build and operate highly available production services, including telemetry, monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and durable corrective actions. 

- Engage with customers and partners to understand scenarios, translate requirements into technical solutions, and resolve complex issues. 

- Influence engineering investments using service data, customer feedback, and operational insights. 

- Mentor engineers, provide high-quality design and code reviews, and raise engineering standards. 

- Contribute to an inclusive engineering culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, learning, and customer impact. 

Qualifications
 
Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience. 

- Strong design, coding, debugging, and problem-solving skills in C#, C++, Java, or another object-oriented programming language. 

- Experience designing, building, shipping, and operating production-grade cloud services or large-scale distributed systems. 

- Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, fault tolerance, consistency, networking, storage, performance, and scalability. 

- Experience owning complex technical components from design through production operations. 

- Ability to work independently, make progress in ambiguous problem spaces, and drive alignment across engineers and teams. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs. 

- Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through design reviews, code reviews, operational reviews, and technical guidance. 

- Experience with Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or related search technologies. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with information retrieval, semantic search, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, or knowledge retrieval systems. 

- Experience designing and operating services on Azure or another large-scale cloud platform. 

- Experience with service observability, capacity planning, performance optimization, reliability engineering, incident management, and live-site operations. 

- Experience coordinating across teams to deliver complex technical initiatives or restore service during critical incidents. 

- Ability to reason across application, network, caching, queuing, load-balancing, storage, compute, and distributed service layers. 

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools or agentic engineering workflows to improve software development productivity and quality. 

- Strong customer empathy, sound technical judgment, and a track record of delivering durable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

title: Software Engineer (Data Platform, 3-5 years)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

We're looking for a talented and driven Software Engineer, Backend to join our engineering team in Bengaluru, India. In this role, you'll design and develop robust, scalable backend systems that power our products and services. You'll work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, take ownership of complex technical challenges, and contribute to building innovative solutions in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your technical expertise while making a meaningful impact on our organization's success.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services with a focus on code quality, performance, and maintainability

- Ability to understand, own and make changes to large scale systems that stores and process data at petabyte scale.

- Experience with big data stack applications like Hive, Yarn, Spark, Kafka, Impala, HDFS, YARN, Map-Reduce, Airflow, Presto, Superset

- Build into robust, scalable, and supportable Data Warehouse / Data Mart solutions that work well within the overall system architecture.

- Architect robust solutions that adhere to separation of concerns and follow industry best practices

- Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans

- Build and optimize APIs, ensuring they are well-documented, efficient, and aligned with REST principles

- Implement and maintain relational and NoSQL databases, optimizing queries and data structures for performance at scale

- Write clean, unit-tested code using Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies and participate actively in code reviews

- Profile, debug, and optimize system performance across distributed architectures, identifying and resolving bottlenecks

- Mentor junior engineers and foster a collaborative team culture centered on continuous learning and engineering excellence

- Participate in the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on Linux platforms, from design through deployment and monitoring

- Proactively identify technical debt, propose solutions, and drive incremental architectural improvements

- Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, documenting design decisions and technical solutions clearly

Required Qualifications
- Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent professional experience demonstrating strong technical foundation)
- Programming Expertise: Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, C, C++, Python, or Go; ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
- DataEngineering: Experience in building highly scalable business applications, which involve implementing large complex business flows and dealing with a huge amount of data. 
- System Design & Architecture: Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and principles for building scalable, modular systems
- Concurrency & Multi-threading: Hands-on experience with multi-threaded programming and concurrent systems
- Database Proficiency: Solid knowledge of relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike, MongoDB)
- API Design: Experience designing and building RESTful APIs with clear documentation and thoughtful interface design
- Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
- Testing & Quality Assurance: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience writing unit tests and integration tests
- Linux Platform: Comfortable working in Linux environments and familiar with command-line tools and development workflows
- Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems and develop efficient solutions
- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate effectively with diverse teams
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building highly scalable distributed systems handling large volumes of data and complex business logic
- Contribution to open source Big Data applications would be a huge plus.
- Deeper understanding of systems to tune data applications in on-premise or cloud would also be a huge plus
- Understanding of the industry’s coding standards and an ability to create appropriate technical documentation.
- Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture
- Experience with message queues and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
- Knowledge of caching strategies and technologies (e.g., Redis, Memcached)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
- Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team growth
- Track record of working in high-growth, dynamic startup or fast-paced corporate environments
- Passion for staying current with emerging technologies and industry best practices

description:
About Company:

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

 

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

 

Who You Are

 

As a Staff Data Engineer, you lead the design and optimization of scalable data processing solutions that support healthcare-focused products and business outcomes. You work across engineering, architecture, and business teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality data capabilities using modern cloud and big data technologies. You bring deep technical expertise, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to solving complex data challenges in a fast-paced environment.

 

What You'll Do

 

 - Lead the evaluation and integration of advanced data processing technologies and frameworks within AWS to improve scalability, performance, and reliability.

 - Design, build, and optimize distributed data pipelines using Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Snowflake, Spark, EMR, and related technologies.

 - Document technical designs, architecture decisions, and project scope to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and delivery expectations.

 - Partner with business stakeholders and architectural leads to translate requirements into compliant, high-quality data solutions.

 - Review system designs, code, and test plans to strengthen engineering quality and promote consistent development practices across the team.

 - Analyze and resolve complex data engineering problems by applying structured troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and sound technical judgment.

 - Architect AWS-based solutions that support efficiency, scalability, security, and operational resilience across data platforms.

 - Automate software delivery, infrastructure configuration, and testing processes to improve deployment speed, stability, and production uptime.

 - Implement monitoring and observability practices that enable proactive issue detection and ongoing performance optimization.

 - Apply security and compliance standards, including healthcare-related requirements, throughout the software development lifecycle.

 

What You'll Need

 

 - 5+ years of programming experience in Java required.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

 - Expertise in Spring Boot, SQL, Snowflake, and big data technologies such as EMR and Spark.

 - Experience with AWS services including ECS, Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, and S3.

 - Ability to design monitorable infrastructure and automated testing processes that identify defects early and support production uptime.

 - Mature, security-conscious use of AI-assisted development tools for activities such as debugging and testing, with rigorous manual validation and guidance to junior team members.

 - Proven track record of managing complex projects in high-pressure scenarios.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

 - Knowledge of healthcare regulations and standards, including HIPAA.

 - Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly learning new tools, frameworks, and business domains, and applying that learning to improve solutions and team outcomes.

 - Show leadership through influence, collaboration, and constructive partnership with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders, including navigating differing viewpoints to drive progress.

 - Adapt effectively to changing priorities, evolving technologies, and ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivery, quality, and business outcomes.

 - Apply creative thinking to solve data engineering challenges, improve processes, and identify practical, innovative approaches that create business value.

 - Use analytical skills to evaluate complex technical issues, interpret data patterns, and make evidence-based decisions that improve system performance and reliability.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- As Senior Principal Software Engineer develop strategic methods and principles to improve the technical stability and efficiency of the company's products/services.

- You lead and influence several teams and initiatives.

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute.

- Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge.

- Sets product direction and has ownership over large components.

- Thinks both strategically and tactically, keeping in mind both technical goals and company goals.

- Given long term strategic goals, can lay out a path across many versions.

- Participates in and supports initiatives outside of main area of responsibility.

- Provides technical leadership for projects including 3–4 individuals.

- Builds strong relationships in their own team and across the company.

- Understands multiple points of view and drives a process to conclusions in a timely and respectful manner.

- Mentor others with high-level technical guidance.

- Improve the company’s technical prowess.

- Put customers first and set strategic short-term targets.

- Take up open-ended problems.

- Designing, coding, and debugging software.

- Improving the performance of existing software.

- Providing training to other engineers.

- Maintaining and upgrading existing software.

- Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity.

- Supervising and overseeing the technical aspects of projects.

- Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance.

- Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues.

- Work with testing team to develop performance test plans and cases.

- Research and collect product information and support the development of specifications and requirements for consideration.

You Are

- High technical and/or technological competence

- Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field

- Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java based development projects using RESTful APIs, SpringBoot, Micro services.

- Strong analytical skills.

- Good communication skills.

- Excellent organizational and leadership skills

- Proven experience in high-level programming languages, like Java.

- Proven experience in software development methodologies.

- Proven experience building complex web systems.

Extra Awesome

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field

- Expertise with running web services at scale.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Senior Consulting Software Developer (Health Information Exchange)
description:
ORACLE CSS INNOVATION STUDIOS

Senior Consulting Software Developer - Health Information Exchange

Develop customer-specific Millennium solutions for the HIE team.
About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)
Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.
Why join CSS?

 - 
 Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.

 - 
 Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.

 - 
 Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.

 - 
 Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.

 - 
 Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Industry Studios
Industry Studios bring an industry-focused approach to customer co-innovation, connecting business priorities and domain knowledge with Oracle technologies. The work centers on understanding industry processes, identifying valuable use cases, and shaping solutions that address operational needs. Depending on the role and engagement, this can include discovery workshops, prototypes, industry-specific accelerators, and collaboration with AI, applications, cloud, data, and security specialists. Join Industry Studios to deepen your domain expertise while translating customer challenges into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Oracle Health:
Oracle Health is reimagining the future of healthcare by connecting clinical, operational, and financial data across the entire care continuum. Combining the proven clinical depth of the Millennium platform with the scale, security, and AI capabilities of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our consulting practice partners directly with healthcare providers, hospital networks, and public health organizations worldwide to implement, optimize, and modernize their health IT ecosystems.
Role Overview
Based in India in the HIE (Health Information Exchange) team, you will develop customer-specific Oracle Health Millennium solutions using Cerner Command Language (CCL). You will own assigned projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Working with customers, consultants, and clinical teams, you will deliver reports, extracts, clinical print outputs, labels, and requisitions that address clinical and operational needs. Your responsibilities include analysis of the Millennium data model, performance troubleshooting, code reviews, customer testing, and production readiness. You will maintain technical documentation and handover guides, communicate progress and risks, and contribute reusable scripts and delivery improvements. The role requires strong CCL and SQL skills, full-lifecycle delivery experience, and the ability to manage assigned work independently. You will also use Oracle-approved AI development tools with effective prompts, appropriate technical context, and critical review of generated code and documentation, retaining accountability for quality and validation.
Key Responsibilities

 - 
 Gather requirements, assess feasibility and prepare technical designs, effort estimates and delivery plans.

 - 
 Develop and enhance CCL reports, data extracts, clinical print outputs, labels and requisitions.

 - 
 Analyze Millennium tables, fields, relationships and code sets to implement accurate data retrieval and processing.

 - 
 Troubleshoot functional issues, data discrepancies and performance problems in custom solutions.

 - 
 Conduct code reviews, prepare test cases and validate outputs against agreed requirements.

 - 
 Coordinate customer testing, resolve defects and support packaging, deployment and production readiness.

 - 
 Maintain technical documentation, project summaries and customer handover guides.

 - 
 Communicate progress, dependencies and risks to customers and project stakeholders.

 - 
 Use Oracle-approved AI tools and reusable components across delivery, including code review and documentation, while retaining accountability for quality and validation.

 - 
 Mentor colleagues and contribute reusable scripts, technical guidance and delivery improvements.

Skills - Mandatory
Education

 - 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Oracle Products

 - 
 Strong hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting CCL solutions in Oracle Health Millennium.

 - 
 Sound understanding of the Millennium data model and clinical or operational workflows.

Technical Skills

 - 
 Proficiency in SQL, relational databases, query optimization and data validation.

 - 
 Experience with version control, code reviews, testing and controlled deployments.

 - 
 Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Oracle-approved ChatGPT and Codex.

 - 
 Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant technical context and critically review AI-generated code and documentation.

Experience

 - 
 Experience delivering custom reports, extracts or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle.

Functional Skills

 - 
 Ability to independently manage assigned work, estimate effort and resolve complex technical issues.

Stakeholder Management

 - 
 Clear communication skills and the ability to translate customer requirements into technical solutions.

Work Requirements

 - 
 Willingness to work the 4 p.m.–1 a.m. IST shift.

 - 
 Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed and permitted by local regulations.

 - 
 Perform other responsibilities as assigned and follow corporate and organizational security policies and procedures, including safeguarding corporate and client assets and preventing and reporting security compromises within the scope of the role.

Good to Have

 - 
 Experience with Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS for custom interfaces and workflow enhancements.

 - 
 Experience with MPages, Discern Rules, PIE, DA2 or healthcare interfaces.

 - 
 Familiarity with pharmacy, laboratory, blood bank, registration or financial reporting workflows.

 - 
 Experience supporting customer implementations and go-live activities.

Self Assessment Questions
Before applying, please consider the following questions:

 - 
 Can I demonstrate strong hands-on CCL development and troubleshooting experience in Oracle Health Millennium and knowledge of its data model and workflows?

 - 
 Am I proficient in SQL, relational databases, query optimization, and data validation?

 - 
 Have I delivered custom reports, extracts, or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle, using version control, code reviews, testing, and controlled deployments?

 - 
 Can I independently estimate and manage assigned work, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate customer requirements as technical solutions?

 - 
 Do I have the specified bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, and can I demonstrate effective use and critical review of Oracle-approved AI development tools?

Role Overview
Based in India in the HIE (Health Information Exchange) team, you will develop customer-specific Oracle Health Millennium solutions using Cerner Command Language (CCL). You will own assigned projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Working with customers, consultants, and clinical teams, you will deliver reports, extracts, clinical print outputs, labels, and requisitions that address clinical and operational needs. Your responsibilities include analysis of the Millennium data model, performance troubleshooting, code reviews, customer testing, and production readiness.

title: Senior Software Engineer - FullStack
description:
At Xplor, we help businesses thrive by making life simple for daily activities with a recurring nature. We do that by offering smart software, payments, and commerce-enabling solutions across five “everyday life” verticals: Education, Health and Fitness, Boutique Wellness, Field Services and Personal Services. 
At Xplor Mariana Tek, our mission is to simplify fitness studio management by making it approachable, effortless, and focused on the people who matter most.
Our core values - Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members

Who We’re Looking For
We’re looking for a full stack senior software engineer who can design and write code in a multi-tenant SaaS environment. The candidate needs to be highly collaborative, productive in a dynamic development environment and be willing to utilize AI in their day-to-day work.
Job Description
- Collaboration with teammates and other functions in a geographically distributed remote environment
- Hands-on development with Python, Django, Ember and PostgreSQL
- Creating well-designed, testable, efficient systems following company processes and industry best practices
- Leading technical design initiatives and efforts
- Troubleshooting and resolving software defects
- Utilizing PRs as a path to teach and learn
- Shared ownership for team dynamics, processes and growth

Qualifications and Skills
Must-haves
- 6+ years of professional software development experience
- Python and Django (REST APIs, models, migrations)
- PostgreSQL and comfort writing / reasoning about SQL
- Multi-tenant SaaS (tenant isolation, shared vs tenant data)
- JavaScript framework experience
- Git / GitHub and PR-based delivery
- Use of Docker for local development
- Writing and maintaining robust tests
- Willingness to utilize AI in day-to-day work
Strongly preferred
- Django REST Framework (or equivalent API framework)
- Redis and background jobs (queues, scheduled work)
- Payments / billing (Stripe or similar)
- AWS basics (S3, RDS, containers)
- Auth (sessions, OAuth, permissions)
- Use of Feature flags
- Frontend: Ember or another modern SPA (routing, data layer, forms, components)
- Debugging production issues from logs and stack traces
Nice to have
- Experience using AI in software delivery
- Observability (Sentry, log platforms, tracing)
- E2E tests (Playwright or similar)
- CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
- Integrations (email, analytics, maps)
- E-commerce / POS / cart flows

Ready to apply?
To start your application, please submit your resume and we’ll be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.
Before you apply
To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in India. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within India. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.
Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.
We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process xplor.com/recruitment-faqs/.

Interview Recording and Background Checks
As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.
EEO and Artificial Intelligence
We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.
Xplor is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We provide equal opportunities to all our employees and to all eligible applicants for employment in our company. title: Software Engineer 2
description:
Overview
Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
 
Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role:

A Lead Software Development Engineer (Lead SDE) at Razorpay is a well-grounded, innovative, quality-focused product thinker and business-conscious engineer - not a mere coder. Armed with deep technical context and extensive experience, you will build production-grade, highly scalable software and see nuances and edge cases that others might overlook.

At our scale, engineering creates a massive impact across global digital payments. Beyond technical excellence, you are expected to operate with a strong ownership mindset in ambiguous environments, act as a technical leader, mentor peers, and actively influence and shape Razorpay’s culture in the right way.

What you will build:

- Architecture & Design Thinking: Drive ambiguous requirements into clean, low-level designs (LLD) with clear interfaces, data flows, and non-functional requirements (NFRs) before execution.

- Engineering Leadership & AI Augmentation: Act as the "tech lead of an AI agent loop". Lead development by utilizing AI-augmented workflows and engineering assistants strategically—handling prompt decomposition, constraint management, and rigorous code validation.

- Scalable Systems Delivery: Build full-fledged applications and payment infrastructure from scratch, driving features to completion. Transition systems seamlessly across complex architectural scales.

- Code Quality & Integrity: Maintain high-quality implementation standards with clean abstractions, SOLID principles, and modular, maintainable code. Take full ownership of all code codebases, performing independent navigation, debugging, and strict verification without AI assistance when required.

- Product & API Strategy: Actively participate in and drive product and design discussions. Shape our public-facing REST APIs for developers worldwide and brainstorm new directions to make online payments easy and accessible.

- Robust Testing & Resilience: Implement comprehensive verification strategies—including unit, integration, adversarial, and known-risk testing—to ensure error-free functionality under multi-limit and distributed failure modes.

- Collaboration & Mentorship: Mentorship of engineering peers, clearly articulating technical trade-offs, defending architectural decisions, and engaging in constructive discussions across teams to prioritize end-user value.

What we are looking for:

- 5+ years of experience in professional software technology, preferably within a fast-paced product company.

- Expert working knowledge and deep fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., GoLang, Java, Python).

- Strong grasp of both High-Level Design and Low-Level Design. Proven understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, data storage trade-offs caching, and event-driven architectures.

- Resiliency Patterns: Solid understanding of system failure modes and modern mitigation patterns.

- Familiarity with Agentic Workflows. Ability to break complex engineering problems down into structured, promptable tasks while maintaining complete accountability for code safety, security gaps, and hallucination detection.

- Understanding of web architectures, HTTP protocols, and REST API conventions.

- Demonstrated ability to challenge the status quo, evaluate complex technical trade-offs rationally, and display immense agility when iterating on products at scale.

- A strong willingness to learn and unlearn new technologies to deliver the best possible product outcome.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Summary
Build cutting‑edge C++ software for next‑gen mask inspection systems. Work with cross‑functional experts and tackle complex, high‑impact engineering challenges. AI/ML experience is a big plus.

Description
KLA RAPID Division is seeking a highly motivated individual with strong foundation in C++ programming and interest in data analysis. The ideal candidate will demonstrate good problem‑solving and debugging skills and will work on multi‑threaded and multi‑process programming environments. Experience with AI-assisted (agentic) development methodologies or hands-on working experience with machine learning (ML) is a strong plus.

In this role, you will develop inspection and data analysis software for advanced mask inspection systems. You will work closely with experienced software engineers and collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams—including electrical, mechanical, optical, algorithm, and software teams—to gain domain knowledge and help solve system‑level challenges.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and develop inspection software and data analytics solutions for advanced mask inspection systems.

- Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams to define and implement system requirements.

- Optimize and maintain existing codebases to ensure performance, scalability, and reliability.

- Provide support during beta‑site ramp‑up and handle escalations from customer sites.

Preferred Qualifications
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- Proven experience in C++ programming, object‑oriented design, and design patterns.

- Strong background in data analysis, including statistical summaries and predictive modeling.

- Proficiency in Linux‑based development environments.

- Strong leadership qualities, teamwork skills, and motivation for team success.

- AI/ML experience with large‑dataset model development is a plus.

- Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and workflows.

- Familiarity with frontend development stacks such as Qt or other modern UI frameworks (Electron, Gtk).

- Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Singularity) for packaging software services.

Minimum Qualifications
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About Maru Kaam AI
Maru Kaam AI is Gujarat's first WhatsApp reminder platform, built by Maru Kaam Labs Pvt Ltd in Ahmedabad. People send a bill photo, a text or a voice note - light bill, gas refill, rent, EMI, school fees, GST deadline - and our AI reminds them on WhatsApp before the due date, in English or Gujarati. No new app. We are pre-launch and building our founding team.

What you'll do
- Build and own our backend in Node.js/TypeScript: message intake, reminder scheduling and delivery
- Integrate the WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API: webhooks, message templates, media handling
- Connect our AI services (OCR, speech-to-text, LLM extraction) into one reliable pipeline
- Build a simple React admin dashboard for support and analytics
- Design the database (PostgreSQL/MongoDB) for users, reminders and schedules
- Deploy and monitor on Linux/cloud; keep reminders on time, every time

What you'll bring
- 1–3 years of hands-on experience with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript
- Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks
- Working knowledge of React and one SQL or NoSQL database
- Comfort with Git and deploying to a Linux server or cloud platform
- Ownership mindset: you ship, test and fix without being chased

Good to have
- Prior work with WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, Gupshup or similar messaging platforms
- Job queues/schedulers (BullMQ, cron, Redis)
- Ability to read Gujarati (helps when testing Gujarati reminders)

Salary and benefits
- ₹4.8–7.2 LPA CTC, based on skills and interview
- Hybrid: 2 days a week together in Ahmedabad, rest from home

- Work directly with the founding team ; your code goes live from day one

Hiring process
- Apply on LinkedIn (Easy Apply)
- 20-minute intro call
- Short practical task (max 2 hours)
- Final conversation with the Founding Team and offer

We never charge candidates any fee at any stage.

Maru Kaam Labs is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and hire on skills alone.

At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! - PostgreSQL and an ORM (Sequelize or similar) used seriously in production, including migrations and query performance
- Job queues and async processing (BullMQ, Sidekiq, or equivalent)
- You've owned checkout, billing, subscriptions, or similarly unforgiving money flows: idempotency, retries, webhook reconciliation

title: Staff Engineer, Full-Stack Development
description:
Full-Stack Web Developer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting.

You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications.

Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js
- Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
- Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic
- Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into working software that solves real problems
- Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache
- Contribute to AI-enabled features including retrieval-augmented generation workflows, prompt engineering, and automation that pulls from internal knowledge repositories
- Support CI/CD pipelines and help maintain production systems through monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning

The Impact You Will Have

- Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
- You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
- The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
- Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30,000-person global organization
- You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
- Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
- You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
- 5+ years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
- Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js in real projects, not just side experiments
- Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design
- Experience using Prisma or a comparable ORM for data modeling, schema migrations, and database access patterns
- Familiarity with Docker for containerization and exposure to Kubernetes, Nginx, or Apache in deployment contexts
- Practical exposure to AI technologies such as large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or automation workflows, whether through work, coursework, or personal projects
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles
- Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

Who You Are

- You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
- When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
- You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
- You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
- Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to apply them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
- You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
- You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
- Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.

The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.

What You’ll Own

- Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
- System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
- Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
- System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
- Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
- Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
- Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
- Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
- Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
- AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are

- Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
- Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
- Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
- Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
- Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
- Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
- Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
- Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
- Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
- Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
- Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
- Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
- Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Who We Are

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation.

We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

About The Role

Platform Science is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Orion (Fleet Management System) department in Chennai. In this role, you will be a key contributor to our cloud-native full-stack development efforts, designing and deploying robust, high-performance software for high-velocity fleet solutions. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will work with an innovative mindset to solve complex problems and ensure the successful delivery of projects that impact the global transportation industry.

Essential Responsibilities

- Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using Node.js, Vue.js, React.js, and TypeScript, ensuring maximum performance across a variety of web-capable devices. 
- API & Backend Architecture: Create efficient internal and external APIs and develop optimized database schemas for both RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (ElasticSearch) environments. 
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Deploy and manage applications on AWS, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to ensure high availability, scalability, and security. 
- Quality Engineering: Write clean, modular, and testable code; conduct thorough unit, integration, and performance testing (using frameworks like Jest or Enzyme) to ensure software reliability. 
- Collaborative Innovation: Partner with Product Managers and Architects to translate requirements into technical specifications while automating CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps team. 

Experience

Required Experience
