title: Lead Full-Stack Agentic AI Engineer
description:
R Systems is a global digital product engineering company that helps enterprises design, build, and run AI-native, data-driven, and cloud-native products and platforms. Our AI, Data & Intelligent Engineering teams partner with U.S. enterprise clients to move AI beyond isolated pilots toward governed, production-grade "Enterprise Digital Brains" — unified platforms that combine modern data engineering, semantic ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Role OverviewAs a Lead Full-Stack Agentic AI & at R Systems, you will bridge principal architecture blueprints and day-to-day engineering execution for U.S. enterprise clients. You will lead small engineering pods to build end-to-end agentic applications, semantic knowledge layers, and full-stack user experiences — turning architectural designs into reliable, observable, and governed production systems.
We are looking for a true full-stack engineer with deep, hands-on experience across modern frontend frameworks, backend services, API design and enterprise integration, real-time streaming, and production AI — someone who writes a significant share of the critical-path code while raising the bar for the whole team.
Key Responsibilities• Lead Agentic & Graph Engineering: Architect and implement multi-agent workflows (PydanticAI, LangGraph, Celery), MCP tool servers with scoped access, and temporal/semantic knowledge layers (Graphiti, Neo4j, Elasticsearch) with data curation pipelines (Argilla, distilabel, spaCy, GLiNER, tree-sitter).
• Frontend Engineering Leadership: Lead frontend delivery in Angular (standalone components, signals, RxJS/NgRx), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with React/Next.js where required; build rich data and graph experiences with ECharts and AntV G6 / d3-force; implement streaming chat/agent UIs, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), and performance budgets.
• Backend & Service Engineering: Build and own backend services in NestJS and Python (FastAPI), with Java/Spring Boot or Go as needed; apply domain-driven design, clean architecture, and resilient patterns (retries, circuit breakers, outbox, idempotency).
• API Design & Enterprise Integration: Design and implement REST/OpenAPI, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs; integrate with client systems of record (Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday) and third-party APIs via API gateways (Kong, AWS API Gateway, Apigee) and iPaaS where present; harden auth with OAuth 2.1/OIDC, SSO (Okta, Entra ID), JWT, OTP/magic links, and Redis sessions.
• Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Systems: Build event-driven pipelines and services with Apache Kafka/Confluent, Amazon Kinesis/MSK, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, and CDC (Debezium); deliver real-time updates to UIs and agents over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events.
• Ontology & Knowledge Layer Implementation: Translate ontology designs into graph schemas, Cypher/SPARQL queries, entity-resolution logic, and GraphRAG retrieval with hybrid (BM25 + vector) search and re-ranking.
• Enforce Governance, Security & Observability: Implement AI Gateway policies, Amazon Bedrock guardrails/routing, RBAC, hash-chained audit logs, OpenTelemetry tracing, LLM evaluation gates, and AWS CDK / GitHub Actions CI/CD security checks.
• Mentor & Unblock Engineers: Conduct code and design reviews, pair with mid-level and intern engineers, and translate blueprint requirements into clear technical tasks, estimates, and sprint deliverables.
Technical SkillsDeep hands-on expertise in the core stack is expected; breadth across the alternatives is a strong plus.
Frontend Frameworks• Core: Angular (v17+ standalone components, signals, RxJS, NgRx), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (design tokens).
• Breadth: React, Next.js, Vue; micro-frontends (Module Federation); Storybook design systems; Jest, Playwright/Cypress testing.
• Visualization: ECharts, AntV G6, d3-force, Cytoscape.js; real-time dashboards and graph explorers.
Backend, APIs & Integration• Services: NestJS (Node.js), Python (FastAPI, Uvicorn, Celery); Java/Spring Boot or Go a plus.
• APIs: REST/OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL (Apollo), gRPC/Protobuf, AsyncAPI, webhooks; versioning, rate limiting, idempotency, contract testing (Pact).
• Integration: API gateways (Kong, AWS API Gateway, Apigee); MuleSoft or Boomi exposure; Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday APIs.
• Auth: OAuth 2.1/OIDC, SAML SSO, JWT, OTP/magic links (Amazon SES), Redis session revocation, fine-grained authorization (OPA/Cedar/OpenFGA).
Real-Time Streaming• Platforms: Apache Kafka / Confluent (Connect, Schema Registry), Amazon MSK/Kinesis, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, Redis Streams.
• Processing & CDC: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink or Spark Structured Streaming; Debezium CDC.
• Client Delivery: WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, token streaming for LLM responses.
Agentic AI & LLM Engineering• Frameworks: PydanticAI, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex; CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI Agents SDK exposure.
• Protocols & Patterns: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, structured outputs, agent memory, human-in-the-loop approvals, durable workflows (Temporal).
• Models & Gateway: Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Titan embeddings), Azure OpenAI, open-weight models; AI gateway routing, quotas, and guardrails.
• Evaluation & Observability: Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo; LangSmith, Langfuse, or Arize Phoenix tracing.
Ontology, Graph, Search & Data• Graph & Semantic: Neo4j (Cypher, APOC, GDS), Graphiti; RDF/OWL/SHACL and SPARQL familiarity; Amazon Neptune a plus.
• Search & Vector: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (BM25 + vector hybrid), pgvector, Pinecone or Weaviate.
• Data Stores: PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), Redis, DynamoDB/MongoDB; working knowledge of Snowflake and Databricks and medallion architecture.
• NLP Curation: spaCy, GLiNER, tree-sitter, Argilla, distilabel; document parsing (Unstructured, Docling, Textract).
Cloud, DevSecOps & Observability• Cloud & IaC: AWS (ECS Fargate, EKS, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, S3/CloudFront, KMS, Secrets Manager); AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform.
• CI/CD & Security: GitHub Actions, Docker, Trivy, gitleaks, SAST/DAST, SBOM; OWASP Top 10 for Web, API, and LLM Applications.
• Observability: OpenTelemetry (OTLP), Jaeger, CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, Grafana/Datadog; SLOs and alerting.
Qualifications & ExperienceMust-Have• Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years leading technical delivery on AI/LLM, knowledge graph, or complex full-stack cloud systems.
• Full-Stack Mastery: Strong hands-on mastery of Python and TypeScript, at least one modern frontend framework (Angular preferred, React acceptable), and backend service and API architecture.
• Integration & Streaming: Proven delivery of enterprise API integrations and real-time, event-driven systems in production.
• Production AI: Has shipped at least one LLM or agentic application to production with evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
• Ownership: Practical problem-solver who owns outcomes end to end, writes clean maintainable code, and keeps agentic systems grounded, testable, and production-safe.
Nice-to-Have• Consulting/Client Delivery: Experience in client-facing or forward-deployed engineering for U.S. enterprises.
• Domain Experience: BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, or retail.
• Open Source: Contributions to agentic AI, graph, or frontend ecosystems.
Relevant Certifications (Highly Valued)• Cloud: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional or AWS Certified Developer – Associate; Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate.
• Generative AI: AWS Certified AI Practitioner or Generative AI Developer – Professional; Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate; Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate.
• Graph & Streaming: Neo4j Certified Professional; Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka.
• Platform & Security: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD); HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate; CompTIA Security+ or equivalent.
What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)• Pod Delivery: Your pod ships production-ready agentic features on predictable sprint cadence with clear test coverage and observability.
• Quality Bar: Code review, CI/CD security gates, and LLM evaluation gates are consistently applied across the pod.
Team Growth: Mid-level and intern engineers become independently productive on the stack through your mentoring.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers' hands.

We're looking for a highly experienced full stack Senior Software Engineer who works AI-natively and can help push Cin7's engineering practices forward. This role is primarily focused on .NET development across different types of projects, including applications built with .NET Framework, .NET, and ASP.NET MVC, with frontend technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

You'll operate as a senior technical advisor: designing and implementing high-quality .NET solutions, using AI tools and agents to accelerate your own development workflow, helping evaluate and build AI-powered capabilities into our product, mentoring other developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional software at a fast pace.

This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India.

Applying for this role: Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered.

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Partner with product managers, designers, and developers to define requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions. 
- Maintain, design, and develop high-performance code: Maintain and develop our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software using .NET technologies, ensuring solutions meet business needs and follow best practices in software design and development. 
- Contribute to full-stack development: Work across application, database, and frontend layers when needed, including implementing API-driven features, writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures and triggers, making UI updates, adjusting page layouts, working with forms, and applying styling using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
- Work AI-natively: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as a core part of your daily workflow — for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test writing, and code review — while maintaining full ownership and judgment over the resulting code. 
- Help build AI-powered features: Contribute to designing and implementing AI/LLM-powered capabilities within Cin7's product (e.g., integrating LLM APIs, working with retrieval or agentic workflows, evaluating model outputs for reliability), partnering with product on where AI can add real customer value. 
- Lead development initiatives: Take ownership of complex, ambiguous features and modules end-to-end, providing technical leadership, architectural direction, and mentoring to other developers. 
- Code reviews and quality assurance: Review code (human- and AI-generated) for consistency, quality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to coding standards, providing constructive feedback to peers. 
- Optimize performance and reliability: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, scalability concerns, and technical challenges to ensure optimal system performance in a cloud SaaS environment. 
- Champion testing and AI-assisted quality practices: Drive strong unit and integration testing practices, including using AI tools to help generate and maintain test coverage. 
- Adopt new technologies: Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging tools, frameworks, and AI-driven practices to enhance the development process and product quality. 
- Mentor and coach: Foster a culture of growth, quality, and effective AI-augmented development by providing guidance and technical mentorship to other developers, including how to use AI tools responsibly and effectively. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
- Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on software development experience, with deep specialization in .NET technologies, and a track record of senior/technical leadership on production systems. 
- Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) — not just occasional use, but genuine integration into daily engineering practice. 
- Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants as part of everyday software development. 
- Expertise in integrating LLM APIs into an existing application. 
- Experience designing and implementing production-grade AI-powered functionality involving RAG, agentic workflows, and model output evaluation. 
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to independently tackle and resolve complex, ambiguous technical challenges across backend, frontend, database, and application layers. 
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working in teams and mentoring others. 

Core Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in C# and .NET technologies, including deep experience with .NET Framework, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, web applications, and APIs. 
- Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns, with practical experience applying them to complex, real-world production systems. 
- Extensive experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, including writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures, triggers, indexes, and troubleshooting database performance issues. 
- Solid understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, request/response lifecycle, browser behavior, and client-server communication. 
- Working knowledge of JavaScript, including DOM manipulation, event handling, form validation, asynchronous calls, and working with API responses. 
- Solid understanding of HTML and CSS, including semantic markup, page structure, layout basics, responsive behavior, and styling existing UI components. 
- Ability and willingness to work with existing frontend code when needed. 
- Strong understanding of unit testing and integration testing principles, including how tests are written, structured, and maintained. 
- Experience with version control systems, such as Git. 
- Experience working in agile development environments. 

It's a Nice To Have If You Bring

- Experience working with LLM/AI APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI/Azure OpenAI Service) in a production SaaS context. 
- Experience working on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure. 
- Experience improving performance, scalability, and reliability of production systems. 
- Familiarity with automated testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices. 
- Experience mentoring engineers and shaping engineering best practices, including AI tool adoption. 

Why work at Cin7?

- We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
- You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
- Hybrid work environment
- Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
- Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
- A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
- Recruitment referral bonus
- Work for a Great Place to Work®

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are
ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

Why This Role Matters
You own the platform every part of ParamAIQ is built on. The app, the AI features, the integrations for law firms: all of it runs through the API and services layer you build. When a lawyer trusts us with a confidential matter and expects it to be fast, correct, and private, your systems are what make that true.
This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You make the architectural calls, and you write the code that matters most. In legal software a bug is not cosmetic: it is a confidential matter exposed or a filing that fails, so we want senior people who get the foundations right the first time.

What You'll Own
- The product API and services layer: The architecture and the code.
- AI feature systems: Long-running, sometimes-failing operations that still feel fast and reliable to a lawyer under deadline.
- Multi-tenant isolation: Strong enough that one firm's matters are provably invisible to another. In legal, a cross-tenant leak is the worst thing that can happen.
- Data models for legal work: Matters, drafts, versions, and audit trails that stay coherent as the product grows.
- Reliability, performance, and cost: As the system scales.
- The rest of the product surface: Authentication, billing, uploads, exports, and notifications.

The Hard Problems You'll Take On
- Making unreliable, slow AI operations feel dependable: Model calls fail, time out, and cost money. The orchestration, idempotency, and graceful degradation that hide this from a lawyer is a real systems problem.
- Isolation you can prove: Not just separating tenants, but demonstrating and testing that separation across every path in the product.
- Getting the foundations right early: The data models, contracts, and access control you set now are the hardest to change later, and the most expensive to get wrong once real client data is flowing.

What You Bring
- 4+ years of backend engineering in Python, with a framework like FastAPI, Django, or Flask
- You design systems, not just features: you reason about scale, reliability, cost, and failure, and you defend your calls
- You've built multi-tenant SaaS with real data isolation between customers
- Strong API and service design: contracts, versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, backpressure
- Solid PostgreSQL: schema, indexing, transactions, performance
- Real command of auth: OAuth, OIDC, JWT, sessions, RBAC
- You write careful code and test the paths that matter, because you know what a mistake costs here
- Ready to work from our Mumbai office, full-time

Bonus Points
- 0-to-1 and early scale: you've taken a system from first version to real load and know what breaks first
- Performance and reliability work: profiling, load testing, and finding the failure before it reaches a user
- Async and background job systems (Celery, RQ) at scale
- Payments and billing systems (Razorpay, Stripe, or similar) and their failure modes
- Legal-tech, regtech, fintech, healthtech, or another regulated, trust-sensitive domain
- DPDPA, Indian data residency, and security practice

What You Get
- Real ownership of the platform and the architectural calls behind it, from day one
- The chance to get the foundations right on a product handling confidential legal matters
- Work shoulder to shoulder with practising lawyers on a product built for real legal work
- A hand in making justice more accessible in one of the largest judicial systems on earth

title: Full-Stack Developer (AI-Augmented Engineering)
description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

About The Role

We're looking for a full-stack developer to join our growing engineering team. This is primarily a product engineering role — you'll design, build, and maintain web applications end to end — but you'll do it in an AI-native way, relying on agent frameworks and AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle — not as a bonus skill, but as a core requirement. You're expected to understand how the underlying models work well enough to use them effectively and evaluate their output critically.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain production web applications across the full stack (frontend, backend, and data layer).
- Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) throughout the SDLC — from spec and scaffolding through implementation, testing, and review — rather than only for isolated snippets.
- Integrate LLM-powered features and lightweight agentic workflows into product surfaces where they add real user or operational value.
- Work with agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) to build or extend automation that connects LLMs to APIs, data sources, and internal tools.
- Critically review, debug, and refactor AI-generated code — your own and teammates' — with full ownership and understanding of what ships.
- Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code with unit and integration tests, including for AI-generated contributions.
- Collaborate with product and engineering peers to scope features, define API contracts, and ship reliably under deadlines.
- Document designs, decisions, and AI-assisted workflows clearly for the team.

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience (e.g., React on the frontend; Python/Go/Rust on the backend).
- Working understanding of how LLMs function at a practical level — tokens, context windows, embeddings, prompting, and the general shape of what models can and can't reliably do.
- Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) — production use preferred, personal/academic projects acceptable.
- Fluent with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a daily part of your workflow — skilled at providing clear context to get production-quality output.
- Strong code ownership — able to explain and defend every line you submit regardless of how it was generated, and to catch subtly incorrect AI output.
- Familiarity with AI-native SDLC practices — using AI assistance across planning, coding, testing, and review, not just code completion.
- Basic prompt engineering and tool/function-calling fundamentals for working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source equivalents).
- Comfort with REST APIs, JSON, relational databases, and version control (Git).

Nice to Have

- Experience shipping an LLM-powered feature (chat, RAG, summarization, or similar) inside a production web app.
- Exposure to vector databases or semantic search.
- Familiarity with workflow automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Airflow).
- Comfort with both a compiled backend language (Go/Rust) and Python.
- Any personal AI projects, bots, or automation tools you've shipped.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Syncade Developer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position: Sr. Software Engineer – AI Engineer

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. Each of our colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change.

Scope

The EMES Core Platform, Its Components, Interfaces, Data Layer And Tools – Material And Inventory, Order Management, Equipment And Instrument Integration, Sample Management, Patient Scheduling System Integration, Label Printing, Recipe Authoring And Execution, Electronic Batch Records, And Batch Reporting And Analytics – Together With

- AI and GenAI services embedded in manufacturing workflows: assistants, retrieval over controlled documents, anomaly detection and decision support.
- Web applications and operator-facing interfaces across shop-floor, quality and supply-chain personas.
- Enterprise data models, databases, audit-trail architecture and reporting data flows; cloud migration and adoption of next-generation manufacturing systems.

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Design, build and operate production-grade AI services – not prototypes – including retrieval-augmented generation over SOPs, batch records, deviations and equipment documentation, and agentic workflows that act against MES systems under human oversight.
- Own the retrieval architecture (chunking, embedding selection, vector storage such as pgvector or OpenSearch, hybrid search, re-ranking, citation fidelity) and LLM application patterns: structured output and tool calling, MCP servers over enterprise systems, orchestration, cost controls and guardrails.
- Establish AI evaluation and observability: golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression gates in CI, hallucination and drift detection, tracing and human-in-the-loop review.
- Apply classical ML where it is the better tool (anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive quality) and ensure responsible, compliant AI: data classification, IP and PII protection, model and prompt versioning, reproducibility and validation evidence for GxP-relevant use.

Web Application Development

- Deliver full-stack applications: React with TypeScript front ends, component libraries and design systems, and responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces built for gloved, time-pressured shop-floor use as well as office users.
- Build backend services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Java (Spring Boot) exposing REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI-first contracts, secured with OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO and fine-grained RBAC, and write the data access layer with the same rigour as the API (deliberate query design, sound ORM boundaries, pagination, no N+1 access, idempotent writes).
- Implement real-time and AI-assisted experiences – WebSockets/SSE for live batch and equipment status, token streaming with inline citations – alongside validation-rich workflows including e-signature interaction patterns.
- Own quality and performance end to end: automated tests across the stack (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright), load testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) with GitOps delivery of application and database changes together against measured p95 targets.

System and Data Architecture

- Lead the design of distributed, multi-tenant systems: bounded contexts and Domain-Driven Design, service decomposition, API and event contracts, and evolution strategy. Own the data model end to end – conceptual, logical and physical design, deliberate normalization, and referential integrity, constraints and domain invariants enforced in the database rather than only in application code.
- Demonstrate advanced relational expertise: complex SQL, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL), partitioning, deliberate indexing strategy, and performance diagnosis from execution plans, statistics, lock contention and pool exhaustion.
- Apply correct transaction design (isolation levels, concurrency control, idempotency, retry semantics) and migration discipline (Flyway/Liquibase/Alembic, expand-contract zero-downtime rollout, tested rollback), and run databases as production assets on AWS: RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, Multi-AZ, read replicas, pooling, PITR and DR.
- Design regulated-grade data integrity – immutable, append-only audit trails (including hash-chained designs), e-signature records, ALCOA+, retention and archival – satisfying GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 (2nd edition, incl. AI/ML guidance) by design, not documentation alone.
- Design event-driven systems with Kafka (partitioning and ordering guarantees, transactional outbox, CQRS and event sourcing, sagas) and enable analytics without burdening the transactional system through change data capture (Debezium) and dimensional models for batch reporting.
- Reason rigorously about non-functional requirements – capacity, scalability, SLOs, failure modes, circuit breakers, backpressure, graceful degradation when a site link is down – and define caching, queuing and throttling strategy (Redis, SQS/SNS, idempotency keys).
- Architect for hybrid deployment (on-premise and near-line where shop-floor latency demands it, AWS for scale) using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) and IaC; instrument for observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); and apply security by design, mitigating the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

Collaboration and Leadership

- Partner with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, Automation and site IT to translate process needs into system and data design; produce and defend the artifacts of real architecture work (ADRs, design documents, data models, sequence and data-flow diagrams, threat models) and run design reviews; and communicate integration contracts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: TECHNICAL LEAD - Go
description:
### 4. Control Plane Engineer

### Job Summary

You will build the services that operate a large PostgreSQL fleet safely: moving data between servers online, keeping actual state in line with desired state, and Kubernetes operators for clustered PostgreSQL with failover.

### Responsibilities

* Build long-running workflows as persistent state machines that survive crashes and can be rolled back.
* Implement versioned configuration with safe propagation to clients.
* Build reconcilers that compare desired and actual state across many servers and apply idempotent changes.
* Build Kubernetes operators for clustered PostgreSQL: CRDs, failover with fencing, adding and removing readers, rolling upgrades.
* Build drift audits, metrics and alerts so operators can see every move and every clusters state.
* Write failure tests for your own services: kill the process at every state, partition the network, delay acknowledgements.

### Must have

* Go (preferred) or Java, building long-running backend services.
* Kubernetes controllers: controller-runtime or kubebuilder, CRDs, reconcile loops, leader election, finalizers.
* Distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, leases, fencing tokens, at-least-once delivery, crash recovery of in-flight operations.
* Working with a consistent config store (etcd, ZooKeeper or Consul) or a database as the source of truth.
* Linux and Kubernetes operations: debugging pods, networking and storage attachment.

### Nice to have

* Has built or contributed to a database operator (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Crunchy, Vitess or similar).
* PostgreSQL knowledge: replication, DDL and failover behaviour.
* Chaos testing tools (Chaos Mesh, Litmus) or Jepsen-style verification.

### Job Details

* Count: 3
* Experience: 6+ years, 3+ building distributed or infrastructure control systems

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**About the role**

Ginesys Insights 2.0 is our next-generation, multi-tenant analytics and reporting platform for India's leading

retail brands. It replaces a third-party BI engine for about 500 customers. It has a governed semantic layer,

self-service workbooks, dashboards, scheduling and exports, built on Java/Spring Boot, Next.js and Google

BigQuery on GCP.

The product is moving from a fast-built foundation to a production release. We need a hands-on Technical

Lead to own delivery end to end: architecture, release readiness, quality, cross-team dependencies and the

engineering team.

**What you'll own**

**Delivery and planning**

* Own the plan from PRD to delivery: turn the PRD, the metrics catalogue (185 P0 metrics) and the UX

task list into epics, stories, sprints and owners, and keep tracking in line with what has actually

shipped.

* Run sprint planning, estimation, risk and dependency registers, and status reporting to product and

leadership.

* Plan and run the customer migration waves from the legacy BI tool, including parity sign-off.
* Close open scope decisions with Product, for example MVP AI Chat and the open decision registers.

**Architecture and technical direction**

* Own the overall architecture across the Java/Spring Boot backend-for-frontend (BFF), the

Node.js/Next.js/React frontend and PostgreSQL.

* Work with Product and Data Engineering on how business metrics are defined and served, and make

sure the engineering design supports them.

* Strengthen security: centralise authentication and authorisation, prove tenant isolation, and harden

row-level security, column-level security and masking.

* Own the API contract (OpenAPI) between frontend and backend, including versioning.

**Production readiness**

* Stand up staging and production environments on GCP with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). That

includes Cloud Run, Cloud SQL sizing and connection budgets, Secret Manager and IAM.

* Set up monitoring, metrics and tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident management and rollback runbooks.
* Set up release management: versioning, the dev-to-main release train, promotion gates and change

control for database migrations.

* Set up cost governance for cloud and query usage, including usage metering for billing.

**Quality**

* Define and enforce quality gates: coverage thresholds and static analysis; end-to-end tests

(Playwright); automated tenant-isolation tests; and metric reconciliation against control totals from

the ERP source.

* Set code-review standards and guardrails for AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) so

speed doesn't cost correctness or security.

**People and stakeholders**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 engineers across backend and frontend, working with UX/design.

Reduce key-person dependency through knowledge sharing and clear ownership.

* Be the single technical point of contact for Product, the Ginesys One/G1 platform team (SSO, identity

delegation), Security, Cloud/DevOps and Data Engineering (the BigQuery Gold pipeline).

* Drive external blockers to closure: per-user BigQuery identity through Workforce Identity Federation,

scheduler delegation, and SMTP and storage connectors.

**Must have**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years as Tech Lead or Engineering Lead shipping a

multi-tenant B2B SaaS product to production.

* Strong hands-on Java (17+, ideally 21) and Spring Boot 3: REST API design, JDBC/SQL with PostgreSQL,

transactions, Flyway, JUnit and Testcontainers. Able to review and write production code.

* Strong hands-on Node.js and TypeScript: server-side JavaScript, API routes and the backend-for-

frontend (BFF) pattern, npm ecosystem and build tooling.

* Strong hands-on React (hooks, component design, state management such as Zustand or Redux, data

fetching with React Query) and Next.js (App Router, server components, route handlers, SSR).

* Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), IAM, Workload Identity Federation, Secret

Manager, Artifact Registry.

* Secure multi-tenant design: SSO (OAuth2/OIDC token exchange), session management, RBAC, audit

trails, OWASP practices.

* CI/CD with GitHub Actions, containers, and canary or blue-green deployments.
* Proven delivery management: Agile/Scrum, estimation, risk management, stakeholder reporting, and

managing dependencies on other teams.

* Strong written communication. The project is heavily documented (PRDs, API contracts, blocker and

incident logs).

**Good to have**

* Google BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse: query cost control, dry runs, partitioning and

clustering, performance tuning.

* Cube.js or another semantic layer / metric store (dbt metrics, LookML).
* Analytics and BI domain: star schemas, pivots and aggregations, non-additive measures and distinct

counts, metrics spanning several fact tables, row- and column-level security on reports.

* Experience replacing or migrating a BI or reporting tool (Exago, Qlik, Power BI, Looker, Tableau,

Metabase).

* Terraform; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring; SLO-based operations.
* Retail or ERP domain knowledge: sales, inventory, stock movement, margin, GST, Indian number

formats.

* AG Grid Enterprise (server-side row model) or similar data-grid tooling.
* Experience leading teams that use AI coding assistants, and setting review policies for AI-generated

code.

**What success looks like in 6 months**

* Staging and production running on infrastructure-as-code, with monitoring, alerting and a tested

rollback.

* The MVP (Sales, Inventory, Margin catalogue, dashboards, RBAC/RLS/CLS, scheduling) live with the

first migration-wave customers.

* Automated tenant-isolation and metric-reconciliation tests gating every release.
* The backlog, trackers and code in sync, every item with an owner and a sprint.
* No single point of failure for CI/CD or core modules.

The Sr. Front End Software Engineer will own all aspects of the software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance of product features in Docusign software products. You will primarily develop customer facing experiences using React/Typescript, as well as backend API UI-facing code either in NodeJS/C#. You enjoy fast-paced entrepreneurial environments where you can solve difficult problems using current technologies and tools. You collaborate well with other team members when brainstorming, designing, and implementing new solutions. You will also help the team succeed by thinking about ways to improve processes, suggesting ways to make the team more effective, and mentoring and modeling engineering best practices.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Design, develop, and maintain well crafted, responsive and modular UI, using React and Typescript
* Build and maintain microservices and micro-frontend architectures
* Ensure that UI and our entire stack enables responsive and seamless user experiences and functionality
* Work as part of a cross-functional team, proactively get alignment on designs, communicate roadblocks
* Guide and mentor other engineers through design and code reviews
* Work closely with the founders and product managers to understand the why behind each capability in the platform
* Help to drive alignment on the prioritization of engineering-driven priorities alongside product priorities
* Be a key decision-maker in selecting our forward-looking front-end architecture and technology stack
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* B.S. in Computer Science or similar field of study
* 8+ years of professional experience in fullstack software development utilizing frontend and backend technologies, like React, Typescript, or similar OOP
* Experience with modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, WebSockets, etc.)
* Experience with front-stack engineering using TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with React
* Experience building end-user-facing product experiences
* Experience working with designers on design systems as well as authoring and maintaining shared components
* Experience working with front-end analytics and experimentation frameworks
* Experience integrating with REST APIs

  

**Preferred**

* Well-formed opinions based on years of experience ensuring quality through predictable, scalable, and reliable end-to-end testing
* Experience with Microsoft technology stack (Typescript)
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL solutions (e.g., Cosmos DB)
* Experience with Enterprise SaaS software products
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer Role Summary The Senior Full-Stack Developer will play a pivotal part in the design, development, and deployment of the organization’s mission-critical SaaS product suite. Embedded within a cross-functional team of Full-Stack engineers, this role requires a technically proficient engineer capable of working across the full software development lifecycle, utilizing modern cloud-native architectures. The successful candidate will leverage the latest Microsoft technologies, specifically .NET 8+ and Azure PaaS infrastructure, while delivering responsive user interfaces using Angular v18+. Beyond implementation, this role demands a senior level of engagement, requiring active collaboration with both the Technical Lead and Product Owner to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Who we want to work with We are looking for more than just a skilled developer for this role - we are looking for someone who will act as a true leader within the team. The nature of our work requires individuals who can navigate ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership from idea through to delivery and beyond. This role is not about waiting for perfectly defined requirements or relying on constant direction; it’s about actively shaping solutions, contributing to the direction of the platform, and driving meaningful outcomes. By combining strong communication, healthy scepticism, and product awareness, you will help ensure we build the right things in the right way - balancing speed, quality, and long-term value. Ultimately, we want someone who doesn’t just deliver code, but who elevates the team, influences decisions, and plays a key role in building a scalable, globally aligned platform. You are comfortable with ambiguity You can tan take a vague problem and turn it into concrete steps. You ask clarifying questions but don't get blocked by missing details. You make reasonable assumptions AND document them. You show Strong technical judgement You always try to avoid overengineering AND under engineering a solution. You know when to choose a simple implementation versus something scalable. You can explain trade-offs clearly (i.e. performance vs complexity, implementation speed vs maintainability). You show ownership & accountability You own each solution all the way through to completion (edge cases, rollout, monitoring). You take responsibility when things go wrong. Everyone makes mistakes – you learn from them. You take the lead and can act independently You make progress without constant check-ins. You are confident in owning your decisions. You know when to escalate versus when to push through and retrospectively inform us of what was done. You are an excellent communicator You can articulate half-formed ideas and refine them collaboratively. You can explain technical concepts in plain language You know when to respectfully push back when something doesn't make sense You show healthy scepticism You challenge assumptions. You avoid blindly following specifications or industry trends. You can suggest alternative ideas and solutions and more importantly, articulate your reasoning. You have product awareness and own the platform The impact to the end user is the first thing you think about when making a change. You are to grasp the business context and align to our business goals. You focus on the outcome, not just on the output. Key Responsibilities Technical Development & Implementation • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend RESTful APIs and microservices using C# and .NET 8+. • Develop and maintain responsive, client-side applications using Angular v18+ and TypeScript. • Implement and manage cloud-native solutions within the Microsoft Azure environment. • Ensure the stability and reliability of the mission-critical SaaS platform through rigorous unit testing, integration testing, and performance profiling. Collaboration & Strategy • Product Collaboration: Partner closely with the Product Owner during sprint planning sessions and design workshops to analyze requirements, scope features, and translate business goals into technical execution plans. • Technical Strategy: Work with the Technical Lead to define system architecture, conducting feasibility studies and communicating tradeoffs regarding design choices. • Quality Assurance: Participate in code reviews to enforce coding standards and adherence to industry best practices (e.g., SOLID, DRY, etc.). • Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues. Qualifications Education & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in professional software development within the Microsoft ecosystem. • Proven experience developing enterprise-grade or SaaS applications. Technical Skills • Backend: Advanced proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core. Demonstrated experience with .NET 8 or later is required. • Frontend: Strong proficiency in the latest versions of Angular. You should have a solid understanding of core Angular concepts, TypeScript and responsive web design principles. • Cloud: Hands-on experience with Azure PaaS services, for example Azure Functions, Azure App Service, and Azure SQL. • Azure DevOps: Familiarity with Azure DevOps Pipelines, Repos, and Boards for work item tracking is highly beneficial. • Database: Proficiency in relational database design, writing SQL queries, and performance tuning. • Mobile: Any prior exposure to mobile app development would be highly beneficial. Language Proficiency • English: Advanced / Professional working proficiency (C1 level or higher) in both verbal and written English is mandatory for daily collaboration with international stakeholders. What We Offer • Bleeding-Edge Ecosystem: We are committed to staying current. You will work with the absolute latest in the Microsoft stack, including .NET 8+, Angular v18+, and Azure PaaS. You won't be maintaining legacy Web Forms; you’ll be building cloud-native solutions using modern architecture. • Full-Cycle Ownership: Go beyond just writing code. From architecting scalable Azure Functions and designing SQL schemas to crafting responsive Angular UIs, you will have the autonomy to drive features from concept to production. • Collaborative Impact: Work alongside dedicated specialists in Mobile and Frontend architecture. You will be a key player in a cross-functional team where your input on system architecture and API design shapes the future of our mission-critical SaaS platform.

**Additional Information**

**About Us, Our Culture & What We Can Offer You**

Established over 200 years ago, Chubb Fire & Security are a global business driven by keeping people and the world safe. We provide essential systems, equipment and services, from digital CCTV surveillance and intruder alarms, to fire detection and suppression systems. Offering a full range of innovative products and services to a broad range of customers, from local independent business, to many of the FTSE 100 companies

We believe we offer a unique working culture, where you are as important to us as our customers, and we want you to feel that everyday. We are proud to offer extensive training to all of our new Advisors, fully supporting, and enabling you to thrive in your new role and beyond, with ongoing career development opportunities throughout your career journey with us.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to be part of our Platform & Infrastructure organization. This org is responsible for building the foundational systems that drive Samsara's products.

  

**This role is Hybrid - 2 days per week in the office.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You want to build for scale:** With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
* **You are a life-long learner:** We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
* **You believe customers are more than a number:** Samsara Technologies India Private Limited engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
* **You are a team player:** Working on our Samsara Technologies India Private Limited Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

**In this role, you will:**

* Work with product managers, designers, staff engineers, and internal/external customers to architect, build, test, and deliver full stack features across the React and TypeScript frontend, the GraphQL layer, and Go backend services.
* Own the load time and responsiveness of high-traffic dashboard pages that show large lists and maps of assets. Measure them with real user monitoring and tracing, find where the time goes in the browser and on the server, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Improve how pages fetch and render data: sequence and batch requests, defer non-critical work, split and lazy-load code, virtualize long lists, and reduce unnecessary re-renders and main-thread work.
* Design and evolve GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and the backend services and data stores behind them, so that pages get the data they need in as few round trips as possible.
* Roll out changes safely with feature flags, staged releases, and before-and-after measurement, and partner with the Web Experience, time-series, and infrastructure teams on shared dependencies.
* Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, reliability, and user experience of our applications.
* Propose technical solutions and guide the technical direction of some of the team's initiatives.
* Help mentor, develop, and support other engineers on the team, including backend engineers who are growing their frontend skills.
* Maintain a regular feedback loop to allow for implementation iterations and making adjustments.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of relevant industry experience in software development, including production experience on both frontend and backend systems.
* Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and React, including state management, hooks, component design, and automated testing of UI code.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, or Kotlin, and experience building and operating APIs (GraphQL or REST) backed by relational or NoSQL data stores.
* Experience diagnosing and improving web performance using browser developer tools, a React profiler, and real user monitoring or tracing tools.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage technical discussions and mentor junior engineers.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience building data-heavy single-page applications with large tables, lists, or interactive maps (for example Mapbox or Google Maps, marker clustering, and live location updates).
* Deep knowledge of browser performance: Core Web Vitals, long tasks and the main thread, bundle size and code splitting, caching, and the cost of network request waterfalls.
* Experience with GraphQL at scale, including schema design, query batching, pagination, subscriptions or live queries, and client-side caching.
* Experience with observability tools such as Datadog RUM and APM, and with defining and tracking percentile-based performance goals.
* Expertise working with web services at massive scale deployed on hyperscalers such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Experience with real-time or time-series data and with caching strategies for frequently read, rarely updated data.
* Experience working within a design system and building accessible, internationalized user interfaces.
* Experience writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code on large-scale enterprise software applications.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques or using AI-driven tools to improve system reliability, developer productivity, or customer-facing features.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Associate, AI Platform Engineer (Senior Front-End Engineer)
description:
### ***Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.***

**Job Description**

**Front-End Engineering:**
--------------------------

* Design, build, test and support responsive web applications using TypeScript and React.
* Build interactive investment workflows with search, charts and complex tables. Enable users to move between related views, compare data and take action within their workflows.
* Partner with designers to prototype and refine interactions, validate them with users and deliver accessible interfaces.
* Build robust, performant applications with security, stability and resilience embedded throughout design and implementation.
* Build and maintain a shared React component library, including design tokens, documented component APIs, usage examples and automated tests.
* Manage client state and API data, including fetching, caching and runtime validation. Optimize rendering and load times for large datasets through approaches such as pagination, virtualization and progressive loading.

**Shared Workspace & Application Integration**
----------------------------------------------

* Build the workspace features that let users find, open and move between applications with consistent navigation, sign-in and interface behavior.
* Define, document and test how applications connect to the workspace and share context.
* Help teams bring existing and new applications into the workspace.
* Manage shared dependencies and test compatibility so teams can release their applications independently. Work with application owners to diagnose and resolve issues that span multiple applications.

**Backend Engineering**
-----------------------

* Build and maintain APIs and application services that support user-facing features. Where appropriate, combine data from multiple services and cache responses to improve performance.
* Agree API contracts with service owners and implement input validation, consistent error handling, pagination and automated tests.
* Work with existing data stores and service APIs. Write efficient queries and enforce user permissions on the server in line with established security, secrets-management and audit requirements.
* Partner with backend, data and AI specialists on changes that affect shared services or multiple applications.

**Data & AI Application Integration**
-------------------------------------

* Integrate AI assistance with the data and views users are working in - for example, enabling users to ask questions about a portfolio and explore the results through supported charts or filtered tables.
* Handle streamed responses, long-running operations, timeouts and retries where appropriate. Make progress, data freshness and service failures clear to users.

**Engineering Quality, Delivery & Technical Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Own assigned work from technical refinement and prototyping through automated testing, release validation and production support.
* Use unit, component, integration and end-to-end tests appropriate to risk. Validate accessibility, browser compatibility, performance and behaviour across application boundaries.
* Instrument shared features and applications so teams can diagnose issues across the browser, APIs and supporting services. Document how to operate and troubleshoot the features you deliver.
* Contribute to front-end architecture, code reviews and shared engineering standards. Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration.
* Clarify evolving requirements with designers and stakeholders, and communicate estimates, dependencies, risks and trade-offs clearly.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Experience & Background**
------------------------------------

* Typically 6 to 10 years of software engineering experience, with substantial recent hands-on ownership of production front-end applications.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, modern JavaScript, semantic HTML and CSS, including responsive layouts and accessible component design.
* Experience delivering data-rich interfaces and building shared front-end foundations used by multiple applications or teams, such as a component library, design system or application integration layer.
* Strong understanding of front-end architecture, state management, API integration, runtime data validation and performance.
* Working proficiency in at least one server-side language and framework, demonstrated by delivering and testing production APIs or application services.
* Practical understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, database queries, authentication, server-side authorisation and secure handling of sensitive data.
* Experience with automated testing, Git, code review, CI/CD, observability and production troubleshooting.
* Evidence of technical ownership, mentoring and effective collaboration with designers, engineers and business stakeholders. Ability to make sound technical judgements as requirements evolve.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience with micro-frontends or other architectures that allow teams to develop and deploy applications independently.
* Experience with Next.js or a comparable framework, and with libraries for data fetching, caching or runtime validation.
* Experience with charting libraries, advanced data grids, component documentation tools or performance optimisation for large datasets.
* Experience integrating AI services, streaming responses or long-running data workflows into user-facing applications.
* Familiarity with cloud-hosted services, containerised deployments or enterprise data and AI platforms.
* Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated, data-intensive environment.

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Reporting Relationships**

Managing Director, Head of Data Engineering & AI Platforms

*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: Software Engineer - AI & Angular or React
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what's the role all about?**

You will join NiCE's CX engineering organization and help build cloud-native products. You will work in an agentic software development lifecycle, where engineers and AI agents together design, build, test, review and ship. You will not just implement tickets: you will use AI to move faster, raise quality, and rethink how software is built.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Use AI as part of every step of your work: turn requirements into specs, generate and refactor code, write tests, review changes, and troubleshoot issues
* Deliver small-to-medium features from idea to production with growing autonomy, in whichever stack the problem needs
* Build intuitive, polished user experiences, including interfaces for AI-driven features such as conversational assistants, insights and recommendations
* Ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases and technologies, with AI as your accelerator
* Handle edge cases, error states, performance and accessibility before users find them
* Help shape our agentic development lifecycle as it evolves: explore new AI tools, agents and automations, bring what works into how the team plans, builds, tests and releases, and share it with the team
* Collaborate with UX, product and senior engineers, and push solutions forward independently

**Have you got what it takes?**

* B.Sc. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science or equivalent, or a comparable track record of building real software
* 1-3 years of hands-on software development experience
* **AI-first mindset (core requirement):** daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agents; ability to show concrete examples of results you delivered faster or better with AI; good judgment about when not to trust AI output; curiosity to keep experimenting
* Strong engineering fundamentals: OOP/OOD, data structures, testing, APIs and system thinking
* Proven ability to learn new languages and frameworks quickly, and to build real projects end to end

Front-end work is a smaller part of the role: familiarity with React and TypeScript is enough to follow a feature through to the UI.

* Model, query, and optimize data in MySQL, with reliability and performance in mind.

* Debug and profile production issues to their root cause, from the API down to the query.
* Make occasional front-end changes in React and TypeScript when a feature needs them.
* Improve how the team works with AI: shared project instructions, review checklists, and automated checks.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**AI-first engineering**

  

* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents on real production work, beyond autocomplete.
* Can read unfamiliar code quickly and explain why a generated solution is right orwrong.

**Back-end**

* Solid knowledge of MySQL: schema design, queries, indexing, and optimization.
* Understanding of REST API design, authentication, and integration patterns.

Flynaut | Pune (On-site / Hybrid) | Full-time | 1-3 Years Of Experience

**About Flynaut**

Flynaut is a Pune and Charlotte, NC based technology company building apps, modernizing systems, and delivering cybersecurity and managed IT (through our MSP brand, OneProtect) for clients across the US. We are SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified and have worked with names like GE, Toyota, US Bank, and Cummins. Today we ship React Native field-service apps, video platforms, healthcare products on HIPAA-compliant AWS, and notification and delivery apps for growing US businesses.

We have built AI into how we work, not just what we sell. Claude and Emergent are core to how we build, ship, and run operations. We are looking for a developer who thinks the same way.

**The Role**

You will not be a developer who occasionally uses AI. You will be the person who builds with it: prompting, iterating, validating, and shipping real client work faster and cleaner than a traditional dev team. You will take a vague client ask, turn it into a clear spec, build it with AI tooling, test it properly, and own it until it is live.

**What You Will Do**

* Build and ship web and mobile applications using Claude (Claude Code, API) and Emergent as primary development tools, from prototype to production.
* Write precise, structured prompts that produce reliable output. You know how to give AI role, context, format, and constraints, and how to break a large build into prompt chains that actually work.
* Review, debug, and harden AI-generated code. You catch what the model gets wrong before the client does.
* Turn client requirements and change requests into clear scopes, estimates, and build plans.
* Support live client projects across React Native, web apps, and AWS-hosted backends, including post-launch fixes and handovers.
* Build internal tools and automations that save the ops and sales teams time (dashboards, workflows, integrations with tools like HubSpot and Apollo).
* Create reusable prompt libraries, templates, and skill files so the whole team gets faster, not just you.
* Flag risks early: scope creep, security gaps, timeline slips. Bring a proposed fix, not just the problem.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 3 years of hands-on development experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, React or React Native, Node.js or similar).
* Demonstrated, real-world experience building with AI coding tools. Show us what you shipped with Claude, Emergent, Cursor, Lovable, or similar.
* Strong prompting skills. You can explain why one prompt works and another does not.
* Solid fundamentals: APIs, databases, Git, deployment, and basic cloud (AWS preferred).
* Ability to read code critically. AI writes fast; you make sure it is correct, secure, and maintainable.
* Clear written English. You will communicate with US clients and need to explain technical things simply.

**Who Thrives Here**

* You are proactive. You do not wait for a ticket; you see the gap and close it.
* You love solving problems and get bored doing the same thing twice, so you automate it.
* You are curious about new AI tools and test them on your own time.

* You are comfortable moving between client builds, internal tools, and quick fixes in the same week.

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India .

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8–10 years of professional software development experience, with significant exposure to full stack and cloud-native development.
* Experience contributing to at least 5–6 distinct projects or major product releases.

**Primary duties and responsibilities:**

* **Full Stack Application Development**
  + Implement high-quality, maintainable, and efficient back-end and front-end code using ".NET Core", ".NET Framework", "C#", "Python", "Angular", and/or "React".
  + Build responsive, accessible, and cross-browser compatible UIs integrated with robust back-end services.
* **System, Component & UI Architecture**
  + Contribute to system and component-level design, working closely with software architects to refine and implement design patterns and technical solutions.
  + Develop reusable UI components, libraries, and patterns to ensure consistency across applications.
  + Contribute to and refine front-end architecture, including **micro-frontends** (e.g., module-based composition, Module Federation or similar patterns).
* **Data Model Implementation**
  + Implement and optimize data models in collaboration with architects and database engineers to support application performance, integrity, and scalability.
* **API Development & Integration**
  + Develop, document, and maintain secure, robust, and scalable APIs, ensuring adherence to established API design standards.
  + Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and backend services, handling client-side state management, error handling, and performance optimization for API-heavy applications.

  + Design and build cloud-native applications, leveraging containerization, microservices, and managed cloud services.
  + Build and deploy services on Azure using Docker and Kubernetes, following cloud-native best practices (scalability, resilience, observability, and cost-efficiency).
  + Implement and integrate with Azure services (e.g., App Service, API Management, Storage, Identity, Monitoring, CDN) in line with architectural guidelines.

  + Apply OWASP and secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., XSS, CSRF, injection, authentication/authorization, secure session management) on both client and server.

  + Contribute to design systems, style guides, and coding standards for full stack development.

  + Provide technical guidance to junior developers, perform code reviews, and share best practices within the team.
