title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.


About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer IV to help build, scale, and operate our multi-tenant cloud platform on AWS. This platform provides shared APIs, data pipelines, and identity services that support products across PDI.
You’ll work in a modern TypeScript/Node.js environment that includes containerized services and serverless functions, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and an S3/Parquet data lake. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who is comfortable diving into an existing codebase, solving complex back-end challenges, and owning solutions from initial design through production.
You’ll also play an important role in modernizing legacy technology, including helping migrate SQL Server and .NET workloads to our cloud platform.


What You'll Do
- Design, build, test, and deploy scalable back-end services and platform capabilities using TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS.

- Build and maintain multi-tenant APIs and event-driven services using technologies such as REST, MQTT, SQS, and SNS.

- Develop solutions with strong tenant isolation, authentication, and security using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT.

- Research, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues across services, data pipelines, and infrastructure.

- Monitor application and platform performance through logs, metrics, and traces, proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and availability.

- Partner with Product and Support teams to troubleshoot issues, prioritize enhancements, and improve the customer experience.

- Provide senior-level technical input during design discussions and help shape solutions for complex system changes and enhancements.

- Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, security, and supportability.

- Help modernize legacy technology by migrating SQL Server stored procedures and .NET services to cloud-native solutions.

- Contribute to infrastructure as code, container builds, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Write automated unit and integration tests and participate in peer code reviews to maintain high standards for quality and security.

- Help reduce technical debt and continuously improve engineering practices and operational efficiency.

- Participate in the team's on-call rotation and incident response.

- Share ideas, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the continued evolution of the platform.

What You'll Bring
- 6+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 4 years developing and maintaining back-end services using TypeScript/Node.js.

- 4+ years building high-availability, high-volume distributed services on AWS, using technologies such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, and Cognito.

- Strong proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and PostgreSQL.

- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or similar platforms.

- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar technologies.

- Strong understanding of application and cloud security, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, least-privilege IAM, secrets management, and multi-tenant data isolation.

- Experience serving as a technical lead or senior developer on medium- to large-scale projects, with the ability to help drive design, development, and implementation.

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex production issues.

- Ability to evaluate system needs and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and supportability.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

- A collaborative mindset and willingness to dig into unfamiliar technology, ask questions, and learn quickly.

- Ability to influence technical decisions and build alignment without relying on direct authority.

- Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining appropriate engineering, security, and code-quality standards.

Nice to Have
- Experience with C#/.NET or SQL Server, particularly in environments undergoing cloud modernization.

- Experience with data pipelines and analytical data technologies such as Parquet, DuckDB, Iceberg, or change data capture (CDC).

- Experience modernizing or migrating legacy on-premises applications to AWS.

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Overview
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive resiliency and engineering maturity for the Copilot Backend across Microsoft Government Clouds, including GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD.
The Copilot backend, powered by the Sydney orchestration platform, sits at the heart of the Copilot request pipeline, coordinating identity, orchestration, grounding, model and downstream-service calls, safety and compliance processing, persistence, and response delivery.
Deploying this platform into Government Clouds is significantly more complex than progressing the same capabilities through the Worldwide environment. Each Government Cloud is effectively a distinct deployment environment with its own infrastructure boundaries, security controls, data-residency requirements, identity configuration, certificates, service endpoints, telemetry and compliance validation. A Worldwide approval cannot simply be assumed to cover Government Clouds, and security and threat-model validation may need to be completed independently for GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD.
Sydney also depends on several downstream services to complete an end-to-end Copilot request. Government Cloud readiness therefore requires more than deploying Sydney itself. Authentication and app registrations, dedicated endpoints, certificates, environment-specific configuration, routing and isolation, downstream-service readiness, telemetry, monitors, and capacity all need to function correctly within each cloud boundary.
In this role, you will own the engineering work required to make this entire pipeline robust and repeatable. You will design and implement mechanisms that allow Copilot capabilities proven in Worldwide to safely progress through Government Clouds, replacing fragile and manual processes with reliable engineering systems for deployment, certification, validation, monitoring, rollback, and live-site operations.
You will:
- Design and implement resilient deployment and certification pipelines for Copilot Backend capabilities across GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD.

- Build cloud-aware automation for configuration, flight progression, validation, telemetry, alerting, and release health while respecting Government Cloud security and compliance boundaries.

- Identify and eliminate parity gaps between Worldwide and Government Clouds, including problems involving dependencies, identity, certificates, routing, capacity, monitoring, and operational readiness.

- Partner with feature and platform teams to establish a repeatable path from Worldwide release to Government Cloud production, rather than solving each Government Cloud deployment as a one-off engineering exercise.

- Bring Government Cloud environments toward the same engineering maturity as Worldwide by extending telemetry, alerts, live-site practices, and incident-response capabilities across the deployment rings.

- Design for failure: define health gates, rollback mechanisms, dependency validation, and observability so that failures are detected early and releases can progress safely.

- Work closely with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure engineering solutions satisfy cloud-specific compliance requirements without sacrificing deployment velocity.

What makes this role challenging
This is not simply a deployment role. The core engineering challenge is to build a Government Cloud release and resiliency platform that makes compliance a property of the pipeline rather than a recurring manual obstacle.
Today, progressing capabilities through Government Clouds can involve cloud-specific dependencies, configurations, certification, telemetry and operational steps. The opportunity for this position is to turn those requirements into a robust engineering system where a capability can move from Worldwide through GCC-M, GCC-H and DoD with clear readiness signals, automated validation, strong observability and predictable failure handling.
Success in this role means that Government Cloud reliability and feature availability no longer depend on heroic manual effort. Instead, Copilot Backend has a secure, compliant, observable and repeatable pipeline for safely shipping and operating capabilities across every supported cloud.

Responsibilities
- Own Government Cloud resiliency for Copilot Backend. 
- Build a robust WW-to-Gov deployment pipeline. 
- Engineer compliance into the release process. 
- Drive reliability and operational parity with Worldwide. 
- Improve certification and release validation. 
- Own end-to-end dependency readiness. 
- Design for failures and safe recovery. 
- Eliminate cloud-specific toil. 

Qualifications
Required Qualifications: 
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python- OR equivalent experience. 

Preferred Qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in software engineering and solid technical skills.  
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
- Solid software engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed backend services.
- Solid understanding of cloud architecture, deployment systems, service reliability, observability, and incident management.
- Experience designing automated CI/CD, validation, release-gating, and rollback mechanisms for production services.
- Ability to diagnose complex failures spanning services, infrastructure, networking, authentication, configuration, and downstream dependencies.
- Experience operating services in security- or compliance-sensitive environments; Government Cloud experience is a plus but not required.
- Solid engineering judgment with the ability to turn ambiguous reliability problems into simple, scalable, and durable platform solutions.
- Proven ability to drive technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and influence architecture and engineering practices without direct ownership of every dependency.
#CAP #Copilot
 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
